name: Alien Cookies
summary: **Alien Cookies** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Motherland Genetics]]. A cross of their [[alien-abduction|Alien Abduction]] line and a [[durban-cookies-kush|Durban Cookies Kush]] male that combines [[thin-mint-gsc|Thin Mint GSC]] with [[ogkb|OGKB]], it introduces [[durban-poison|Durban Poison]] ancestry and is grown as a mostly indica hybrid with varied phenotypes.
